extraRules: Node and browser checks run through build2 too: `build2 node ...`. Chromium stays headless. Never run xdg-open or open a window.
Never touch the dev hub on 45752, the coordinator's preview on 49575, `.data/` or `.demo-data/`. Tmux only through the private `-L oui-<pid>` server, never Max's.
Read-only reviewers run screen scripts with the SHOTS_DIR their command gives, so committed PNGs stay unchanged.
No npm or pnpm install except the TypeScript dev dependencies Task 6 pins (through `just ln-setup` after Task 6).
Never modify ~/src/t3-bridge or ~/src/paseo-bridge, never pair/re-pair or write any t3-bridge token or config; tests use fakes.

Tests, vet, node tests and screen scripts run on a build box via `just bb <cmd>` (docs/BUILDBOX.md), never on xsm. Only gofmt, git, `just isa-check` and `go list` run locally. Never run two ui-shots on the same box at once; if a screen check flakes, rerun it once before treating it as a regression.
